anchor.description: The point around which the rotation happens.  Either as an {x:number, y:number} object where x and y represent percentages such that {x: 0, y: 0} represents the (0%, 0%) or top-left corner of the component, or as a valid css transform-origin string.

oneOf.description: A valid css transform-origin property string value.

angle.description: How much to rotate the component.  Valid values include numbers (as degrees), and valid CSS angle strings such as '45deg', '2rad', '0.5turn', etc.

oneOf.description: Degrees of rotation around the anchor point.
A valid css angle string value
